summary_en: Develops an all-fiber photoacoustic endomicroscopy platform that combines proximal scanning through a high-density fiber bundle with broadband fiber-optic ultrasound detection. The 2.5-mm probe provides dual-wavelength volumetric vascular and oxygenation imaging with 7.7-um lateral and 67.5-um axial resolution and is demonstrated for layer-specific monitoring of experimental colitis.

summary_en: Introduces an all-optical PACT system built around an arc-shaped array of flexible fiber ultrasound transducers whose polymer-coated structure provides low- and high-frequency acoustic detection. The system reports approximately 5.2-Pa detection limit, about 70-um cortical resolution, imaging through roughly 1.2 cm of mouse brain, and improved blood-oxygenation quantification from the dual-frequency response.

summary_en: Characterizes how melanin absorption and epidermal ultrasound backscatter jointly bias photoacoustic image quality and oxygenation biomarkers in a 42-participant cohort spanning Fitzpatrick I-VI and vitiligo. The work goes beyond characterization by introducing a spectral-colouring correction and adapting plane-wave reconstruction to suppress backscattered-ultrasound artifacts, making it directly relevant to robust quantitative PAI reconstruction.

summary_en: Introduces a skull-conforming acoustic holographic lens that physically encodes subject-specific volumetric wavefront correction. The design pipeline jointly uses target geometry, anatomical segmentation, acoustic properties and therapeutic constraints, and ex-vivo human-skull experiments validate reconstruction of the intended pressure fields. This is a strong acoustic-holography/coded-wavefront addition even though its immediate application is transcranial ultrasound delivery rather than diagnostic imaging.
